citation: 2026-07-12 representative-date fix (see CLAUDE.md changelog): Thomastown's reachShare ~7% figure this fixture previously asserted was itself a symptom of the single-representative-date bug (most of Thomastown's real 559/561/566 bus stops were being zeroed out by a calendar_dates.txt exception on the one date sampled). With the multi-date median fix, real bus coverage reaches ~73% of the suburb at a genuine ~19min headway, so the old 'can't walk to it' framing is no longer accurate and the self-contradiction it guarded against no longer applies.
Verdict refactor spec: Deanside's binding constraint is unreachable stops (a coverage/reach problem), not unreliable service once reached -- the reliability qualifier must not fire here.

Verdict refactor spec: Pakenham mixes hourly V/Line-style bus feeders with turn-up-and-go metro trains; the quoted headway must describe one population-weighted mode group, not a blended average across both.
Healthy inner-Melbourne control (GOOD band, reachShare 1.0 as generated) to catch REACH_CRITICAL overfiring on well-served suburbs.
